title: Pass two-household CGNAT and network-chaos gate
goal: Prove all networked modes and supported local/remote player combinations over relay without inbound ports.
acceptance: Two distinct households behind restrictive NAT/CGNAT complete sessions with confirmed relay route
Loss/jitter/reorder, unauthorized peers, reconnect, host loss and extended soak have explicit outcomes
validation: Record RTT/loss/relay identity without tokens or public IPs
Run regression with direct UDP deliberately unavailable
